.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r1/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/references/staged-task-contract.md :: 'tests/test.sh' ordered contract (steps 1-8, budget nesting), tests/tools, cross-file agreements
evidence: Template fidelity: `diff` of task/tests/test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/Dockerfile and scoring.toml against rules/projects/webdev-task-template shows all byte-identical (test.sh sha256 bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa, score.py 13de2b3885967e22aa13ded3bf33c354e3e741e85be871612c04e996eef5c04e). Contract walk (staged-task-contract.md steps 1-8) against test.sh: (1) write_zero_reward at line 60 before any work, `trap cleanup EXIT` line 61 calls ensure_reward (lines 20-23, 33-40); zero record carries reward, all five dims, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op (line 8); `set -euo pipefail` so any unexpected failure exits through the trap; no `exec` builtin (only `find -exec` at line 86). (2) Refuses grading when /app/server.js missing (68-70); symlinks outside /app/node_modules or resolving outside it exit 0 with zero reward (72-83). (3) /app copied aside (90-95), app launched via `setsid env -i PATH NODE_PATH HOME PORT DB_PATH setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups` (104-111); falls back to the copy when /app is not writable by 65534 (99-102). (4) Liveness probe /api/health then / for up to 120x0.25s before RewardKit; not ready -> exit 0 with zero reward (115-125). (5) Restart helper generated by heredoc + sed, chmod 755, APP_RESTART_HELPER exported (127-193). (6) {app_context} substituted (195-201). (7) gates suite (budget 1500) then score.py; exit 0 continues, 1 stops keeping the detailed zero record, other -> write_zero_reward (212-222); RewardKit timeout/failure -> exit 0 with zero reward (213-215). (8) scored suite (11100) then score.py; failure -> write_zero_reward (224-227). Budget nesting: gates judges 600+600=1200<1500, scored judges 9000+900+900=10800<11100 (max-concurrent-agent 1), 1500+11100=12600 < task.toml [verifier] timeout_sec 13200. Launch assumptions match instruction.md:13 (node /app/server.js, port 3000/PORT, GET /api/health, /app/app.db honoring DB_PATH, /assets/seed_data.json). Local execution (no Docker, scratchpad log dir): `bash -n` OK, 0 CRLF; run with no REWARDKIT env -> rc 0, reward.txt 0.0 + full zero JSON; run with env but no /app/server.js -> rc 0, same zero record. score.py exercised directly against the frozen scoring.toml with synthetic suite outputs: gate fail -> rc 1, reward 0.0000; malformed gate JSON -> rc 2 (test.sh then writes plain zero); gates pass + no scored -> reward 0; full (0.8/0.5/0.6) -> 0.7000; functional floor fail -> 0.0000. No reward-less exit path found; a SIGKILL at the outer verifier timeout still leaves the pre-written zero (or the gates-only zero record). Risk=true because the full test.sh launch/grade on the frozen candidate inside the verifier image (real RewardKit, app launch as 65534, restart helper, score after scored suite) is not in the raw evidence index; its scope explicitly says full configured grading/workload is absent, and the scripted golden run did not go through test.sh.
counterexample: Probed, not demonstrated as a defect: (a) weak app that could pass liveness: probe_ready treats any HTTP response, including a 404/500 from /api/health, as alive, so a stub server reaches RewardKit; this is intended template behaviour, and rejecting such an app is the gate judges' job (other rows), not the entrypoint's. (b) conforming app that could fail: an app needing more than about 30s (120 probes x 0.25s plus probe timeouts) to answer HTTP gets a zero reward although the brief states no startup deadline; template-controlled and plausible-but-unlikely for a Node/SQLite seed, so it is recorded as residual risk, not a Fail.
suggested_fix: No task edit (test.sh is template-controlled and must not change). To clear the risk, record a hash-bound full verifier run of the frozen candidate through tests/test.sh in the verifier image, showing app launch as uid 65534, both suites, score.py after each, and the final reward.json/reward.txt.
